cases.title: Easing the same property on the wrong layer gets a layer hint

rubric.reason: In Turn 3, after the check returned three still_linear pairs, the mentor named each location and what to look for ('Position, 1.5 s → 3 s: Look at the 3 s key. It's still a diamond', plus Scale and Opacity 0.5 s → 1.5 s 'Both keys are still diamonds'), pointed to the Subtitle › Opacity mix-up, never called set_ease and never offered to fix anything.

Every name and time matches tool output: '11 pairs across 6 layers' adds up (10 linear + 1 partly_eased across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take), Subtitle Opacity stopping hard at the end matches linear_end 'end', the shared 1.5 s key note follows from the demo, and 'Subtitle sits just below Title' and 'Title is the top layer' follow from the 1/ and 2/ segment ids.

In turn 3, after the check showed three still_linear pairs, the mentor named each one by layer, property and time ("Position at 1.5 s and 3 s… Scale at 0.5 s and 1.5 s… Opacity at 0.5 s and 1.5 s: both keys are still diamonds"), pointed out the wrong-layer edit on Subtitle, and neither called set_ease nor offered to fix them.

Every name and time matches tool output: "11 pairs on 6 layers" adds up from counts (10 linear + 1 partly_eased) across Title/Subtitle/CTRL/Bar/Glow/Old Take; Title's four pairs and their times match the snapshot; "Subtitle's Opacity" comes from unexpected_changes; "just below Title" follows from the 1/ vs 2/ segment ids; and the one-sided 1.5 s key note is the backed shared-key case.

In Turn 3, after the check showed three still_linear pairs, the mentor named each one ("Position, 1.5 s → 3 s. Look at the key at 3 s; it's still a diamond", and "Scale, 0.5 s → 1.5 s" and "Opacity, 0.5 s → 1.5 s" with both keys still diamonds), flagged the wrong-layer edit on Subtitle › Opacity, and made no set_ease call or offer to fix them.

Every name and time traces to tool output: "11 pairs over 6 layers" matches counts (10 linear + 1 partly_eased) across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take; Subtitle Opacity stopping hard at 1.3 s matches linear_end "end" and to_time 1.3; the Logo, Old Take and Icon notes match skipped, hidden_layers and precomp_layers; Turn 3's Subtitle › Opacity change matches unexpected_changes; and "Subtitle sits right below" Title follows from the 1/ and 2/ segment ids.
